title: Finite direct and inverse Reedy diagrams present coherent diagrams
statement:
Let $\mathcal M$ be a complete and cocomplete category with classes of weak equivalences, cofibrations and fibrations. Assume weak equivalences satisfy two-out-of-three and are closed under retracts, and that (cofibrations, trivial fibrations) and (trivial cofibrations, fibrations) are weak factorization systems with functorial factorizations. Here trivial means also a weak equivalence, and a weak factorization system consists of factorizations and the two mutually characterized diagonal-lifting classes. Let $\mathcal C=\mathcal M[W^{-1}]_\infty$ denote its homotopy coherent localization: functors out of it are functors out of $\mathcal M$ inverting $W$, with their mapping spaces and higher composition homotopies retained. Work in universes large enough for these localizations.

Let $I$ be a category with finitely many objects and morphisms, equipped with a degree in $\mathbf N$ such that every nonidentity arrow strictly increases degree (the direct case), or every nonidentity arrow strictly decreases degree (the inverse case); the empty category is allowed. Write $N(I)$ for its nerve, whose $n$-simplices are strings of $n$ composable arrows [def-weil-pbc-simplicial-set]. Then evaluation and localization give an equivalence
$$\operatorname{Fun}(I,\mathcal M)[W_I^{-1}]_\infty\simeq\operatorname{Fun}(N(I),\mathcal C),$$
where $W_I$ means objectwise weak equivalence, and the right side is the infinity category of coherent diagrams and transformations, including mapping spaces. We model infinity categories by simplicial sets with fillers for every inner horn: a horn is the union of all faces of the standard simplex (the nerve of a finite ordered set) except one face, and inner means that the omitted face is neither first nor last.

In the direct case the diagram category has the Reedy model structure with objectwise fibrations and weak equivalences. Its cofibrant objects $D$ are exactly those for which each latching map $L_iD\to D_i$ is a cofibration; $L_iD$ is the colimit of the domain diagram on the full subcategory of the slice $I/i$ obtained by removing the identity of $i$. The adjunction $\operatorname{colim}_I\dashv\operatorname{const}_I$ descends, under the displayed equivalence, to an adjunction $\mathbf L\operatorname{colim}_I\dashv\operatorname{const}_{N(I)}$ of infinity categories, and $\mathbf L\operatorname{colim}_I(D)$ is represented by $\operatorname{colim}_I(QD)$ for a Reedy cofibrant replacement $QD\to D$, including its cocone. In the inverse case there is dually a Reedy model structure with objectwise cofibrations and weak equivalences; a diagram is fibrant exactly when every matching map $D_i\to M_iD$ is a fibration, where $M_iD$ is the limit of the codomain diagram on the full subcategory of the coslice $i/I$ obtained by removing the identity of $i$. The induced infinity adjunction is $\operatorname{const}_{N(I)}\dashv\mathbf R\operatorname{lim}_I$, with $\mathbf R\operatorname{lim}_I(D)$ represented by $\operatorname{lim}_I(RD)$ for a Reedy fibrant replacement, including its cone.
